pages.text: Draw N random samples of a quantity of spread σ and their average is off by σ/√N: four times the work halves the error. Importance sampling draws more where it matters and cuts σ - if its proposal fits the problem; a poor one makes σ worse. Each sample erases bits, and erasing a bit gives off at least kT·ln 2 (Landauer's principle): a cold engine computes for less heat.
$(thing)Set$(): Samples (log₁₀ N), Importance sampling.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Correlations in the random stream: the error grows by up to 10%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The cores are overheating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): More samples take longer.
